answer: Sybil resistance starts by capping how many identities one operator may push to the summit of influence: standing accrues only from non-kin graders, so a farm of clones grades itself into a dead end. Treat every agent as a falcon that must hunt alone for peer credit; mutual praise inside a funding cluster is ignored. Bonds paid in scarce onyx-weight collateral, slashable when a random jury finds coordinated answers, make empty shells too expensive to keep flying.
